p.n: The Rat Decides on a Pact with the Cat

body.p:
“Then he said, ‘I see no more excellent strategy than to seek reconciliation with the cat,
for the cat has been beset by the kind of trouble that no one can rid him of], except me.
Perhaps, if he listens to
what I’m going to address him with-truthful words that bear no deceit-he would understand me and would desire
my help, reconciling with me for his own benefit, wherewith bringing], for me and him, salvation.’”
“So he said to him, ‘How are you?’ He said, ‘As you would fancy - in dire straits!’

p.n: The Rat Points Out Their Common Problem

body.p:
The Rat said:
‘{I shall tell you something in which I will not lie: I swear that before I found delight in everything that saddened you, and I viewed that which constrained
you as comforting to me. Today, however, I have joined you in trouble
and have been so beset by dire straits that your death cannot delight me-I am your partner in misfortune], and I can only hope to be delivered
